I replied to Tobias in his thread in #central-random. I noted that the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats and said I won't do anything else with it, as he asked. I also suggested he correct his post in #central-team so nobody there uses the old number.

A seat count isn't a finance figure, and he posted it in that channel himself, so repeating it there was fine. I didn't look at #central-team or say what his earlier post contained.
